ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) across the central and proximal regions, with high-intensity (white) regions concentrated at the distal lateral margins of both lobes, creating a roughly 80:20 black-to-white ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white contiguous blocks are located at the lateral tips; a large circular black spot is embedded within the white region of the right lobe; central area is a solid low-intensity black field with minor grey mottling near the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a sharp interior angle approximately 45 degrees, showing a depth roughly 15% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration with irregular peak-to-valley amplitudes visible along the entire trailing edge; left lobe shows more pronounced, jagged peaks compared to the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curve from the median notch extending to the lateral tips, resulting in a distinct 'butterfly' wing silhouette.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast white rings (rosette scars) scattered across the black ventral surface, including a prominent pair on the lower-left lobe and a large single ring on the upper-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct parallel, light-grey linear streaks (rake marks) oriented vertically on the mid-left lobe, and several faint diagonal abrasions on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization present on the extreme lateral edges and tips of both lobes, appearing as high-contrast, three-dimensional textured clusters.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique vertical line of white speckling or 'splash' marks extending from the bottom center toward the median notch.
